description: The line plot illustrates the average performance of IDK tuned models on closed-book factual sentence completion benchmarks as a function of their parameter count. The x-axis, labeled "Model Size (log scale)," spans from 70m to 7.0B, indicating the logarithmic scale of the model sizes. The y-axis, labeled "Avg. Performance (%)," ranges from 0 to 80, representing the percentage of average performance. The plot features three lines, each representing a different performance metric: Precision (red line with triangle markers), Recall (blue line with square markers), and F1-score (purple line with diamond markers). The Precision line starts at approximately 70% for the 70m model size and ends near 80% for the 7.0B model size, showing a slight increase as the model size grows. The Recall line begins around 20% for the 70m model size and rises to about 40% for the 7.0B model size, indicating a more significant increase in performance with larger model sizes. The F1-score line starts at roughly 10% for the 70m model size and climbs to around 30% for the 7.0B model size, also demonstrating a notable improvement as the model size increases.
